content.comment_body: Hello, I am able to write to coil addresses 8193-8196 successfully, but when connecting the [product_name] expansion module [product_name] DM16 230R 8DI/8DO, writing to 8197 is not possible. The same issue occurs when reading discrete inputs from the expansion module. The [product_name] base module is set up as a Modbus server on port 502 and does not contain any program. Any suggestions? [user_name]

Hello, Your addressing for [product_name] outputs appears correct. Have you verified that the [product_name] expansion module is properly connected and functional with the [product_name] base module? Diagnostic steps to check: - LED indicator on the module - Ensure the module's slider is positioned to the left For confirmation, you can create a [product_name] test program linking Q1 to Q5 through Q12. If Q1 is enabled, the corresponding outputs on the module should also activate. Please send a list of the order numbers you used so we can verify you have the correct ones. Hope this is helpful.

analysis.insight_summary: A user reports successful Modbus communication with certain coil addresses but cannot write or read outputs or discrete inputs on a connected [product_name] expansion module, with only the Modbus server configured and no custom program. The reply confirms the setup logic and troubleshooting, and recommends checking hardware connection and the correct order numbers, along with performing basic diagnostic steps.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects reliable Modbus read and write access for all outputs and inputs, including those provided by the connected [product_name] expansion module, regardless of whether a user program is present.
